acme_email.description: Email for Let's Encrypt (automatic HTTPS). Recommended for public sites; leave empty for internal-only.

sites.description: Sites. Each: domain, optional upstream (reverse proxy) OR root (serve files), and tls (empty = automatic HTTPS, 'internal' = self-signed, or '<cert> <key>').

upstream.description: Reverse-proxy target, e.g. localhost:8080. Takes precedence over root.

root.description: Document root to serve files from (used when no upstream).

tls.description: TLS: empty = automatic HTTPS; 'internal' = self-signed; '<cert> <key>' = explicit.

extra.description: Extra raw directive for this site (e.g. 'encode gzip').
